facts.text: I asked for a summary of the current legislative agenda for the New South Wales Parliament.
I asked what bills are being considered in the New South Wales Parliament right now.
I asked for more details on the COVID-19 Recovery Bill and the exact measures it proposes.
I said I do not see anything about direct financial assistance for individuals who have lost their jobs due to the pandemic.
I asked what the government is doing to help people who have lost their jobs due to the pandemic.
I said the COVID-19 Disaster Payment does not cover everyone.
I said many people are still struggling to make ends meet.
I asked what the NSW Government is doing to address the gap in financial assistance.
I said the NSW Government's efforts are not enough to help individuals who have lost their jobs.
I said the Jobs Action Plan and education programs may be helpful but do not put food on the table or pay rent.
I asked for more direct financial assistance to individuals who have lost their jobs.

keyphrases: New South Wales Parliament legislative agenda
